thread:
Nora (PM): Customer request from BetaCorp: compact route-level observability in Console. They want fast triage for cost spikes + errors. Can we propose an MVP surface for next sprint?
Jamal (SRE): Agree we should constrain. MVP candidates: per-route 7d cost sparkline, error-rate badge, and a single drilldown to a sampled trace for the latest error. No full trace timeline initially.
Owen (Backend): Technically: runtime can emit a lightweight error envelope: `error_event(route,trace_id,model,token_count,cost_usd,err_code)`. Storing only on error reduces ingest.
Priya (Frontend): I can design a compact card to sit in Routes list: cost sparkline, % delta vs prior week, error badge (red/amber/green), and a link "View trace" that opens a small modal. Sketches by EOD.
Grace (Data): For joins: use `route_id + model_variant`. Sampling strategy: default 0.5% for stable routes, 5% for routes with error_rate > 0.5%. We should support on-demand fetch of full trace when user clicks "View trace".
Nora (PM): Good. Let's make acceptance criteria explicit: 1) Card shows 7d cost and delta, 2) Error badge shows 3s summary (count, rate, last seen), 3) "View trace" opens modal with single sampled trace + token-span highlighting if available. Launch gate: <5% increase in observability infra cost for pilot tenants.
Jamal (SRE): Estimate: backend + schema + sampling toggles = 6 dev days. Frontend card + modal = 4 dev days. Data + queries = 2 dev days. Total ~12 dev-days. We can trim runtime to only emit on errors to cut cost.
Owen (Backend): Proposed telemetry schema example:
```
{
  "type":"obs.error",
  "route_id":"r_123",
  "model":"gpt-x-8k",
  "trace_id":"t_987",
  "token_span_start":120,
  "token_span_end":145,
  "token_count":25,
  "cost_usd":0.0025,
  "err_code":"timeout"
}
```
Priya (Frontend): Fallback plan if traces are disabled: modal shows top 3 log lines and recent aggregate error rate. Keeps card useful without tracing.
Grace (Data): I'll prepare baseline metrics: avg route cost per week, median MTTI (time to investigation) for last 60 days. Quick SQL to get route error counts:
```
SELECT route_id, COUNT(*) as errors, AVG(time_to_investigate) as avg_mtti
FROM route_errors
WHERE ts > now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY route_id
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
Nora (PM): Rollout: enable for 5% of routes (pilot customers) for 72h. KPIs: detect-to-triage time down 25% and no more than 4% increase in telemetry spend for the pilot set.
DeployBot: rollout started: obs-mini-card v0.1 -> 1737001500
Jamal (SRE): Cost note: expect event ingest +15% for pilot traffic; storage up small amount with 7d retention. We'll gzip events and batch with 1s coalescing window.
Owen (Backend): I'll add batching and a toggle flag `obs_mini_card=true` at the gateway. 2 days.
Priya (Frontend): I'll post Figma link and two mocks: traced vs no-trace modal.
Grace (Data): I'll post baseline numbers tomorrow morning and instrument the KPI dashboard.
Nora (PM): Thank you. Keep the scope strict. Document design + schema + rollout plan in the PR.
Priya (Frontend): Posted: https://figma.com/file/ExampleMiniCard
Grace (Data): Baseline median MTTI: 22 minutes. I'll attach per-route table tomorrow.
Nora (PM): Perfect. Ship the smallest useful thing.
